patch_description:
The current candidate (score 0.45) regressed below the prior best (0.53) because it added non-parametric CNOT line aggregators and CRX gates that scramble the Y-quadrature encoding before the trainable layers can decode the player sign. The fixed CNOTs create strong fixed entanglement that the limited shared params cannot undo, lowering even train accuracy to 0.33.

I revert to the proven CRY-based motif of the prior best (72-param, score 0.53) but keep a useful improvement: separate RX-sign + RY-decode local layers (sign-sensitive decode) which align with the RX feature map. I remove all fixed CNOTs (they were the regression cause) and replace the CRX entanglers with CRY (which empirically worked best in the prior champions). This keeps parameter count efficient (~84) while restoring the expressive, symmetry-respecting line-segment structure. The combination of a learnable RX offset plus the CRY line entanglers should both fit better and generalize, targeting the 0.53+ regime.
